title: Scorecard
description: A reusable coaching rubric for one call type. A scorecard is a weighted list of criteria; each criterion is scored 0-100 and bucketed into a band (e.g. poor/developing/good/great). Scorecards are plain YAML so anyone can fork and modify them per business.

version.description: Semver-ish, e.g. '1.0'. Bump when criteria change.

applies_to.description: Call-type ids this scorecard is valid for (see config/call_types.yaml).

frameworks.description: Framework ids this scorecard draws on (see frameworks/). Lets the coach cite a shared vocabulary.

scoring.description: How numeric scores map to human bands. Defaults are applied if omitted.

min.description: Inclusive lower bound of this band on the 0..scale_max scale.

weight.description: Relative weight. The engine normalizes weights to sum to 1.0 across criteria.

intent.description: One sentence: why this criterion matters to deal outcomes.

framework_refs.description: Links to framework elements, e.g. 'spiced.pain' or 'meddpicc.economic_buyer'.

what_great_looks_like.description: Observable behaviors that earn a top score. The coach uses these as the gold standard.

evidence_cues.description: Phrases or moves to look for in the transcript as evidence (positive or negative).

coaching_prompts.description: Reflective questions the coach can pose back to the rep.
